author: gobernment
body:
1. Where do you see the network in two years?
2. If you're doing something (policy, deal, promotion)  on the network and the favorability rating on that process is low, how would you address it? Do you see yourself addressing these issues usually well?
3. Is it a statement to confirm that there is no establishment of democracy in the server?
4. What precautions have you taken in order to have the administrators last and not retire/get overthrown?
5. What do you think makes you peak in your admin position? How can you be at your best?
6. Have you focused any attention on learning leadership, both of you admins working together?

Sorry if these sound like interview questions for an admin, but I believe responses to these should be important for the community (and I) to know.

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
1. Where do you see the network in two years?
If we can pull everything off, i see it doing quite well. Sure it won't be 2000 players but i believe we can increase the player count and by quite a bit. I still see it being a very close community.

2. If you're doing something (policy, deal, promotion)  on the network and the favorability rating on that process is low, how would you address it? Do you see yourself addressing these issues usually well?
Well, i'd address it by telling everyone why we made that decision. We don't make decisions because we can, everything we do is for the better. And although, from a players point of view, they might not like the decision but we know what is best for Avicus. 

3. Is it a statement to confirm that there is no establishment of democracy in the server?
I wouldn't call it a "democracy". When we make decisions we take into account the consequences of the decision and we try to get as many opinions into the decision. It would be a democracy in that we would listen to you, when the players know what is best, but it wouldn't be a democracy in that the Admins would make the decisions. 

4. What precautions have you taken in order to have the administrators last and not retire/get overthrown?
We have planned out what will be happening over time. We will be staying for quite some time. 

5. What do you think makes you peak in your admin position? How can you be at your best?
What makes us peak in our admin position? Well, the three of us work very well together. By working together and making decisions together we can be at our best. We also have quite a bit of experience between us. 

6. Have you focused any attention on learning leadership, both of you admins working together?
Yes. We work very well together, not just Ethan and myself but Keenan as well.
